title: StreamPulse
description: Unified streaming watch history tracker across Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and Disney+. Operates 100% on-device with zero proprietary backend or cloud analytics, encrypting session cookies exclusively in Android Keystore.
highlights: 100% Local-First: Zero cloud servers, encrypted keystore session isolation
Hybrid scraping engine with multi-profile and anti-bump accumulation
Sub-10ms composite indexed SQLite offline search and filtering
Binge and rewatch grouping with Italian TMDb metadata enrichment

title: Git Contribution Graph & Tech Stack Analyzer
tagline: Static cross-repository contribution heatmaps and automated tech stack fingerprinting
description: Interactive developer analytics tool that consolidates multi-repository Git history and technology stacks into a unified GitHub-style heatmap dashboard, with zero backend dependency on GitHub Pages.
highlights: 100% Static GitHub Pages deployment with build-time CSV/JSON aggregation
Interactive multi-year GitHub-style heatmap with tooltip project inspection
Automated tech stack detection engine with SVG bubble chart visualization
Deterministic local date rendering fixing cross-timezone shifts
